answer: A copied skipper still needs a unique mooring ring. A candidate locks 8.75 POA and draws one surveyed berth on the reef of a seed-picked river delta. For 11 minutes they lash a tagged juniper spar to that ring and cut a 19-bit grain-hash of berth-id, pubkey, and epoch seed into the spar in minutes 2-8, keeping heading within 4 deg of the seed bearing. 60 aliases would lock 525 POA and 60 exclusive rings. Inspectors re-sight the heading and replay the berth draw from the seed. A reused ring, copied grain-hash, or heading off by more than 4 deg burns 43% and idles that berth for five epochs.
